newsitem.title: UK: ORDEAL BY JAM SANDWICH OVER FOR BRITISH MOTHER.
newsitem.headline: ORDEAL BY JAM SANDWICH OVER FOR BRITISH MOTHER.

text.p: A seven-year-old British boy who ate nothing but jam sandwiches for three years has finally been cured of his addiction, his relieved mother said on Wednesday.
Almira Flatman said her son Craig's habit of eating strawberry or raspberry sandwiches on white bread had been a "nightmare".
She said on BBC radio that she couldn't make him eat other things "because of the way he used to make himself sick and shake and sweat.
"Mealtimes were a really stressful times anyway so we couldn't put him through that," she added.
Craig was treated at London's Great Ormond Street children's hospital, where he overcame his fear of other foods over a six-month period by playing with them and eventually taking tiny bites.
Craig said he had enjoyed some cereal for breakfast and for lunch he planned to have toast, although probably with some jam.
